# Phase 2 model evaluation

**Backtest (simulated)** · generated 2026-10-19T11:27:32.031978+00:00

This expanding-window evaluation predicts each match before kickoff using only earlier results in that league. It reports model quality, not betting performance or a live record.

Input: 287,079 completed fixtures from 1,233 leagues across season labels 2014–2026. Results ingestion queried two season windows for each of 1,242 current leagues, using 2,484 API requests; 2,300 provider requests remained when ingestion completed.

Season-labelled fixture data uses a rolling-origin fold at each new season: the model is fit before the first test-season kickoff and held fixed for that season.

Time decay: exp(-0.003 × age in days); score matrix maximum: 10 goals per side.
Backtest team-count ceiling: 200 per league-season fit.
